text: Hamilton Street is a residential street that runs north-south and is located just west of Broadview Avenue. I have heard from residents, concerned about speeding on their street, requesting that speed humps be installed. I have polled the street and local residents support the installation of speed humps on Hamilton Street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Waived the polling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and authorized the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Hamilton Street between Gerrard Street East and Dundas Street East. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter sections of the roadway to install five speed humps on Hamilton Street between Gerrard Street East and Dundas Street East, for traffic calming purposes, generally as shown on the attached Drawing No. 421G-4097, dated May 2022, from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
